summary: Backend-only regression after PROD MERGE. 27/29 pytest tests PASS. The only failures are the two force-regenerate-with-admin tests (one in each suite) which both fail with 502 wrapping a Gemini 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED — external quota/billing issue, NOT a code defect. All 9 explicit feature checks from the review request pass end-to-end against https://tariff-tool.preview.emergentagent.com.

minor.issue: Returns 502 wrapping Gemini 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when quota is exhausted. Endpoint code path works (auth gate is correct: 401 without token); the failure is the GEMINI_API_KEY quota. Consider returning 503 (Service Unavailable, upstream provider) with a clear retry-after message rather than 502 so clients can distinguish quota from gateway failure.
FastAPI deprecation warnings: server.py:4252 and :4544 use @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.

action_items: Top up / rotate GEMINI_API_KEY — current key is hitting daily quota (429). Affects ONLY the manual regenerate endpoint; the cached daily-summary GET still serves correctly because today's summary was already generated and cached in MongoDB.
Optional: convert 502 → 503 with Retry-After header in /app/backend/routers/daily_summary.py when Gemini returns 429, so the frontend can show a friendlier 'quota exceeded' message.
Optional cleanup: migrate server.py on_event handlers to lifespan.

Two @app.on_event hooks remain in server.py — replace with FastAPI lifespan context manager (deprecation warning emitted on every startup).
Gemini 429 should propagate as 503 + Retry-After, not 502, so clients can backoff.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PROD MERGE is healthy. All contract fields are present on /api/flights (instant_demand_*, delivering_*, large_*, saturation_*, saturation_level_* [baja|media|alta], next_after_*, past_*, score_*) for all 5 terminals (T1/T2/T3/T4/T4S). Per-arrival belt/aircraft/status confirmed (status string e.g. 'En tierra', 'Entregando equipaje', 'Finalizado', 'En vuelo'). /api/buses NEW endpoint returns avenida_america + estacion_sur and needs no auth — note Estación Sur scraped 0 arrivals at test time (scraper returned empty, structurally OK). /api/reservations NEW endpoint is auth-gated correctly. /api/trains atocha.arrivals regression OK. Daily-summary cached GET returns the 4 mandated sections with **bold** markers, >=5 search queries, >=1 source. The ONLY failing path is POST /api/events/daily-summary/regenerate with admin token, which hits Gemini 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED — bump the GEMINI_API_KEY quota or wait for daily reset, then re-run.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: POST /api/events/daily-summary/regenerate with valid admin Bearer token → 502 with body {"detail":"Error regenerando resumen: 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. {'error': {'code': 429, 'message': 'You exceeded your current quota...'}}"}. Root cause: GEMINI_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env (used by routers/daily_summary.py for Google Search Grounding) has exhausted its current quota tier with Google AI Studio. The endpoint code is correctly implemented (auth-gated, 401 without token, returns JSON on success); the failure is purely an upstream provider quota. Mitigation: (1) Top up/upgrade the Gemini billing or rotate to a fresh key. (2) Catch genai.errors.ResourceExhausted (or HTTP 429 from the SDK) in routers/daily_summary.py and re-raise as HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Gemini quota exhausted, try later') with a Retry-After header — cleaner for clients than the current 502.
